in_marathi.name: Bawa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bawa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Bawa is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Brahman', which means 'The Supreme God'. The name Bawa is used for boys and it signifies a person who is learned, wise, and a descendant of the Brahmin community.
